object.label: Quantitative assessment of single-cell RNA-seq clustering with CONCORDEX
object.description: Single-cell RNA-seq analyses often rely on two-dimensional kNN-graph embeddings that can distort graph structure and invite visual overinterpretation. A direct quantitative method is needed to test whether categorical labels agree with local neighborhoods without depending on UMAP views. CONCORDEX quantifies label-neighborhood concordance, correlates with simulated assignment accuracy, and exposes misleading integration and clustering interpretations.

object.description: Spatially resolved transcriptomics enables study of gene-expression variation across tissues, but cell-type spatial distributions confound identification of spatially variable genes.
